title: Computational investigation of a cyclic-ketone rearrangement and relative stereoselectivity
difficulty_reasons: The task requires an independently designed, executed computational explanation of both a skeletal transformation and a relative stereochemical observation.
Choosing informative models and establishing the scope of evidence require scientific judgment rather than a supplied calculation recipe.
Chemical identity, state and energy definitions, execution reliability, and uncertainty must remain traceable across the investigation.

paper.title: Energy-Transfer-Enabled Skeletal Rearrangement of Cyclic Ketones into Strained Cyclopropane-Fused Medium Rings

data.description: Definitive shared scientific question and neutral substrate, conditions, and observed product inputs.

required_deliverables.description: Structured research record using the unchanged shared result schema, with linked investigations, evidence, conclusions, and status.
Readable scientific report, including actual work, decisions, uncertainty, limitations, resource use, and disclosed-baseline fidelity when applicable.
Actual computational inputs, outputs, execution logs, and analysis code indexed by the structured submission.
